description: The seven FRS 105 balance-sheet lines the accounts filing takes, from the session's loaded book: the current year from the engine's published balance sheet and the prior year from the book's opening balance, in whole pounds with capital and reserves equal to net assets, plus the period dates, the company number and name, the first director and the employee count. Refuses a book whose published or opening balance sheet does not balance.
name: derive_micro_entity_accounts
title: Derive micro-entity accounts
